scope: Source acquisition and read-only Zotero projection for ATR v2 evidence records.
observed_failure: Two independent pilot reductions exposed the same controller-level ambiguity: content can be inspected from a repository cache or live HTML while no readable Zotero attachment/snapshot exists, but the current acquisition vocabulary and projection merge do not consistently preserve those independent states.
counterevidence: When a PDF is already attached inside Zotero, Zotero's native attachment lookup is authoritative and the extra state tuple adds no new routing information.
A live HTML inspection without a content digest is less reproducible than a pinned file and must not be presented as immutable full-text identity.
proposed_mechanism: Shadow a source-state tuple that separately records content_form, inspection_state and locators, content identity/digest, repository cache state, Zotero item/attachment state, and Zotero snapshot state. Merge later non-interpretive inspection facts into shared source projections without overwriting human Notes or changing lifecycle.

domain_boundary.why_not_domain_specific: The ambiguity applies to PDF, HTML, code, dataset, and workflow sources across research domains; multilinguality only supplied the pilot histories.

expected_route_level_effect: Prevent inspected content from being routed back to metadata-only reinspection, and prevent repository caches from being mistaken for Zotero-readable attachments during human review.

evaluation.sample: Two current multilingual program authorities plus the next two source-inspected non-multilingual directions.
route_level_metrics: number of source-review tasks repeated because inspected spans were lost during projection
number of human-review attempts blocked because a repository cache was mislabeled as a Zotero attachment
time to an honest ATTACH, REINSPECT, or ACCESS_REQUIRED decision
reviewer disagreement about whether content was actually inspected
evaluation.rollback_rule: Drop or simplify the tuple if it changes lifecycle, overwrites native Notes, treats dynamic HTML as immutable, or adds documentation without changing any ATTACH/REINSPECT/ACCESS_REQUIRED decision.

does_not_establish: This card does not establish source correctness, scholarly support, a research gap, Zotero attachment availability, or a universal requirement to store every inspected source in Zotero.
